dialogues.jp: なき声が聞こえてきた。
dialogues.en: "Wah... sob... boohoo......"
dialogues.text: "Wah... sob... boohoo......"

dialogues.jp: 泣き声と、鳴き声だ。
dialogues.en:
Tears are running down her cheeks and her face is already a
mess. She's holding the cat tightly to her chest.
dialogues.text:
Tears are running down her cheeks and her face is already a
mess. She's holding the cat tightly to her chest.

dialogues.en:
It seems like she still has room to control the strength of
her arms. The cat doesn't look pained.
dialogues.text:
It seems like she still has room to control the strength of
her arms. The cat doesn't look pained.

dialogues.jp:
年の頃は分からない。まあ、背丈で言えば、さ
くらよりちょっと小さいくらいの少女だ。

そして、子猫。種類は……三毛？　よく分から
ないが、どことなく気品を感じさせる。
dialogues.en:
Every time the kitten tries to lick the girl's tears, the
girl moves the kitten's face away.
dialogues.text:
Every time the kitten tries to lick the girl's tears, the
girl moves the kitten's face away.

dialogues.jp:
顔をくしゃくしゃにして、涙をぽろぽろこぼし
ている。胸にぎゅっと猫を抱いて。
dialogues.en: "It hurts...... Yoriko......"
dialogues.text: "It hurts...... Yoriko......"

dialogues.jp:
それでも力の加減はしているのか、猫は苦しそ
うな感じではない。
dialogues.en:
It would hurt, because cats' tongues are rough, let alone
against her smooth cheeks.
dialogues.text:
It would hurt, because cats' tongues are rough, let alone
against her smooth cheeks.

dialogues.speaker: Young Girl
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ〜……なおん……」
dialogues.en: "Boohoo... sob..."
dialogues.text: "Boohoo... sob..."

dialogues.jp:
ほっぺの涙を舐め取ろうとするのだが、その度
に顔を正面に向けられてしまう。
dialogues.en:
And she starts to cry again. She can only turn off the
faucet of tears when she gently chastises the kitten.
dialogues.text:
And she starts to cry again. She can only turn off the
faucet of tears when she gently chastises the kitten.

dialogues.jp:
そりゃ痛いだろうな。猫の舌はざらついている。
ましてや、クリームみたいに柔らかそうな頬な
のだ。
dialogues.en:
The kitten, on the other hand, is just trying its best to
cheer up the girl.
dialogues.text:
The kitten, on the other hand, is just trying its best to
cheer up the girl.

dialogues.jp:
そして、また泣きだしてしまう。涙の蛇口が閉
まるのは、猫をたしなめる時だけ。
dialogues.en: (Well...... What should I do?)
dialogues.text: (Well...... What should I do?)

dialogues.jp:
してみると、あの猫、あれはあれで、少女を慰
めていることになる。
dialogues.en: Of course there is nothing I can do.
dialogues.text: Of course there is nothing I can do.

dialogues.jp: （さて……どうしたもんか）
dialogues.en: Because I'm in a dream.
dialogues.text: Because I'm in a dream.

dialogues.jp: もちろん、どうすることも出来ない。
dialogues.en:
But still, I want to do something when I see a little girl
crying right in front of me.
dialogues.text:
But still, I want to do something when I see a little girl
crying right in front of me.

dialogues.jp: これは、夢の中の出来事だから。
dialogues.en: "What's the matter?"
dialogues.text: "What's the matter?"

dialogues.jp:
とは言え、目の前で子どもが泣いているなら、
どうにかしたいと思うのも、また人情な訳で。
dialogues.en: There's an old lady standing there.
dialogues.text: There's an old lady standing there.

dialogues.jp: 気づくと、そこに、一人の老婆が立っていた。
dialogues.en: (An old lady......?)
dialogues.text: (An old lady......?)

dialogues.jp: （あ？　ばあちゃん……？）

少女と俺の、理由の異なる驚きが、見事にシン
クロした。
dialogues.en:
The girl and I were both surprised at the same time for
different reasons.
dialogues.text:
The girl and I were both surprised at the same time for
different reasons.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「あらあら、可愛い顔が台無しだわ……」
dialogues.en: "Oh no, you're making such a mess on your pretty face......"
dialogues.text: "Oh no, you're making such a mess on your pretty face......"

dialogues.jp:
懐からハンカチを取りだし、そっと顔を拭って
やる。少女は、驚きに固まったままだ。
dialogues.en:
The old lady takes a handkerchief from her pocket and gently
wipes the girl's face. The girl is still looking surprised.
dialogues.text:
The old lady takes a handkerchief from her pocket and gently
wipes the girl's face. The girl is still looking surprised.

dialogues.jp:
白人の女性だ。金髪に青い目。けれど、いつ耳
にしても綺麗な日本語。
dialogues.en:
She's a white lady with blue eyes and blonde hair. But her
Japanese is very fluent every time I hear it.
dialogues.text:
She's a white lady with blue eyes and blonde hair. But her
Japanese is very fluent every time I hear it.

dialogues.jp:
しゃがみ込んで丁寧に涙や鼻を拭っているうち
に、少女の顔にやっと表情が戻ってきた。
dialogues.en:
As she gently wipes the girl's tears and nose, the girl
starts to relax.
dialogues.text:
As she gently wipes the girl's tears and nose, the girl
starts to relax.

dialogues.jp:
言葉が達者だからだろうか、少女は｛おび／怯｝えた様子
も見せず、ありがとうと言った。
dialogues.en:
Maybe because the old lady can speak fluent Japanese, the
girl doesn't look scared at all and says thank-you to her.
dialogues.text:
Maybe because the old lady can speak fluent Japanese, the
girl doesn't look scared at all and says thank-you to her.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「さて、泣いたりして、どうしたのかしら？」
dialogues.en: "So, what made you cry?"
dialogues.text: "So, what made you cry?"

dialogues.speaker: Young Girl
dialogues.jp:
「でも……知らない人と喋っちゃだめって、お
　とーさまに言われてるから……」
dialogues.en: "But...... My father told me not to talk to strangers......"
dialogues.text: "But...... My father told me not to talk to strangers......"

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「そう。あら、可愛い猫ね。頭、撫でてやって
　もいい？」
dialogues.en: "Okay. Oh, you have a cute kitten. Can I pet her?"
dialogues.text: "Okay. Oh, you have a cute kitten. Can I pet her?"

dialogues.speaker: Young Girl
dialogues.jp: 「え？　う、うん……いいよ」
dialogues.en: "What? Y-Yes...... okay."
dialogues.text: "What? Y-Yes...... okay."

dialogues.jp:
乾き、血管の浮き出た手が、猫の頭をそっと撫
でる。猫が気持ちの良さそうな声を出す。
dialogues.en:
The old lady's dried hand shows blood vessels as she gently
pets the kitten's head. The kitten purrs to let her know it
feels good.
dialogues.text:
The old lady's dried hand shows blood vessels as she gently
pets the kitten's head. The kitten purrs to let her know it
feels good.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「可愛いわね。何ていう名前なの？」
dialogues.en: "She's cute. What's her name?"
dialogues.text: "She's cute. What's her name?"

dialogues.speaker: Young Girl
dialogues.jp: 「頼子。この子は、頼子っていうの」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko. Her name's Yoriko."
dialogues.text: "Yoriko. Her name's Yoriko."

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「頼子ちゃん、か。賢そうだし、器量もいいし。
　本当、いい猫ねえ」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko-chan. She looks smart and kind. She's a good cat."
dialogues.text: "Yoriko-chan. She looks smart and kind. She's a good cat."

dialogues.speaker: Young Girl
dialogues.jp: 「うんっ」
dialogues.en: "Yes!"
dialogues.text: "Yes!"

dialogues.jp:
猫を誉められると自分のことのように嬉しいの
か、少女はにっこり笑った。可愛い笑顔だ。
dialogues.en: As the old lady admires the cat, the girl happily smiles.
dialogues.text: As the old lady admires the cat, the girl happily smiles.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「それじゃあ、あなたのお名前はなんていうの
　かしら？」
dialogues.en: "What about you? What's your name?"
dialogues.text: "What about you? What's your name?"

dialogues.jp:
ばあちゃんはばあちゃんで、柔和な、年輪を感
じさせる笑顔。ホッと安心してしまう感じ。
dialogues.en:
The old lady has a gentle smile that reflects her age. Her
smile could make anyone feel comfortable.
dialogues.text:
The old lady has a gentle smile that reflects her age. Her
smile could make anyone feel comfortable.

dialogues.jp:
しばらく考えていた風だったが、結局、少女は
名前を口にした。
dialogues.en:
After thinking for a while, the girl tells the old lady her
name after all.
dialogues.text:
After thinking for a while, the girl tells the old lady her
name after all.

dialogues.speaker: Young Girl
dialogues.jp: 「私は、｛みさき／美咲｝っていいます」
dialogues.en: "My name is Misaki."
dialogues.text: "My name is Misaki."

dialogues.speaker: Young Girl
dialogues.en: (Misaki......?)
dialogues.text: (Misaki......?)

dialogues.jp: どこかで耳にした名前だった。どこだったか。
dialogues.en: I've heard the name somewhere before......
dialogues.text: I've heard the name somewhere before......

dialogues.jp:
考え込んでいるうちに、ばあちゃんの自己紹介
が済んだらしい。カラッとした笑顔を浮かべ、
ばあちゃんは言った。
dialogues.en:
While I'm trying to remember, it looks like the old lady
already introduced herself to the girl. The old lady smiles
cheerfully and says.
dialogues.text:
While I'm trying to remember, it looks like the old lady
already introduced herself to the girl. The old lady smiles
cheerfully and says.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「さ、これでわたし達は、知らない人同士じゃ
　なくなったわ」
dialogues.en: "Well, now we're not strangers anymore."
dialogues.text: "Well, now we're not strangers anymore."

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「改めて｛き／訊｝くけれど、どうして泣いていたのか
　しら？」
dialogues.en: "So I'll ask you again. Why were you crying?"
dialogues.text: "So I'll ask you again. Why were you crying?"

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「あのね、美咲ちゃん。悲しい事辛い事を一人
　で抱え込んでいるのは良くないわ」
dialogues.en:
"Misaki-chan, it's not good to keep something sad to
yourself."
dialogues.text:
"Misaki-chan, it's not good to keep something sad to
yourself."

dialogues.jp:
やがて、ぽつぽつと、少女は──みさきは語り
だした。
dialogues.en: After a time, the girl -- Misaki slowly starts to talk.
dialogues.text: After a time, the girl -- Misaki slowly starts to talk.

dialogues.jp:
引っ越す訳でもないのに、転校しなければなら
なくなったこと。
dialogues.en:
She starts to talk about her transfer to another school even
though she's not moving...
dialogues.text:
She starts to talk about her transfer to another school even
though she's not moving...

dialogues.jp: 外に出て遊んだりしないよう、厳命されたこと。
dialogues.en: And she was told not to play outside.
dialogues.text: And she was told not to play outside.

dialogues.jp:
下々の友達とは、付き合わないようにすること、
それに関してのみさきの話は焦点がぼやけてい
て分かりにくかったが、要約すればそうなる。
dialogues.en:
And she can't play with friends from the lower class -- She
talks long and hard about the subject and it's difficult for
me to understand what her point is.
dialogues.text:
And she can't play with friends from the lower class -- She
talks long and hard about the subject and it's difficult for
me to understand what her point is.

dialogues.jp: そして、話の全てを要約すれば、こうだ。
dialogues.en: And the summary of her story was...
dialogues.text: And the summary of her story was...

dialogues.jp:
──みさきは上流階級の子女なのだから、滅多
な友達と付き合ってはいけない。
dialogues.en:
Since Misaki's from an upper class family, she can't play or
talk with friends from the lower class.
dialogues.text:
Since Misaki's from an upper class family, she can't play or
talk with friends from the lower class.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「そう……。それが嫌で、泣いてたのね？」
dialogues.en:
"I see...... And you don't like it, so you were crying,
right?"
dialogues.text:
"I see...... And you don't like it, so you were crying,
right?"

dialogues.jp: 思い出してしまったのか、涙がじわっと浮かぶ。
dialogues.en:
It looks like she's started to think about it again, and
tears start to fill up her eyes.
dialogues.text:
It looks like she's started to think about it again, and
tears start to fill up her eyes.

dialogues.jp:
途端に猫が身じろぎし、その鼻先を顔にくっつ
けようとしてくる。
dialogues.en:
Instantly the kitten moves and tries to push her nose onto
the girl's face.
dialogues.text:
Instantly the kitten moves and tries to push her nose onto
the girl's face.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「ね、美咲ちゃんは、おまんじゅうとかは好き
　かしら？」
dialogues.en: "Misaki-chan, do you like steamed bean-jam buns?"
dialogues.text: "Misaki-chan, do you like steamed bean-jam buns?"

dialogues.speaker: Young Girl
dialogues.jp: 「え？　う、うん……」
dialogues.en: "What? Y-Yes, I do......"
dialogues.text: "What? Y-Yes, I do......"

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「はい。これを食べて、元気を出して」
dialogues.en: "Here, you can have this, so please cheer up."
dialogues.text: "Here, you can have this, so please cheer up."

dialogues.jp:
スッと手の平を差し出す。そこにはたった今、
好き嫌いを｛たず／訊｝ねられた食べ物が載っていた。
dialogues.en:
The old lady reaches out her hand to the girl, and there's
the food that the old lady just asked if she likes.
dialogues.text:
The old lady reaches out her hand to the girl, and there's
the food that the old lady just asked if she likes.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「さ、遠慮せずに。頼子ちゃんには、そうね、
　淡い風味のこれなんかがいいかしら」
dialogues.en:
"Don't be shy. ......Yoriko-chan, you'll probably like this
one."
dialogues.text:
"Don't be shy. ......Yoriko-chan, you'll probably like this
one."

dialogues.jp:
もう片方の手を差し出す。そこには、白っぽい
色をした｛・・・／おこし｝が乗っていた。
dialogues.en:
She opens her other hand, and there are some white millet
cakes.
dialogues.text:
She opens her other hand, and there are some white millet
cakes.

dialogues.speaker: Young Girl
dialogues.jp: 「いただきます……」
dialogues.en: "Thank you......"
dialogues.text: "Thank you......"

dialogues.jp:
二つの和菓子を手に取り、片方を自分の口に、
もう片方を頼子の口に持っていった。
dialogues.en:
The old lady takes two of them, and puts one to her own
mouth and another to Yoriko's mouth.
dialogues.text:
The old lady takes two of them, and puts one to her own
mouth and another to Yoriko's mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Young Girl
dialogues.jp: 「おいしい……」
dialogues.en: "It's delicious......"
dialogues.text: "It's delicious......"

dialogues.jp:
溢れそうになっていた涙が、見事に引っ込んで
いる。
dialogues.en:
The tears that were about to run down on her face earlier
are gone now.
dialogues.text:
The tears that were about to run down on her face earlier
are gone now.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「話をして、楽になったかしら？」
dialogues.en: "Do you feel better now?"
dialogues.text: "Do you feel better now?"

dialogues.speaker: Young Girl
dialogues.jp: 「あ、う、うん……」

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「そう。でもね、ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "That's good. But I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "That's good. But I'm sorry."

dialogues.jp:
ばあちゃんはぺこりと頭を下げた。大の大人が
幼児に頭を下げる光景は、どこか滑稽だ。
dialogues.en:
The old lady bows. It looks awkward to see an adult bowing
to a kid.
dialogues.text:
The old lady bows. It looks awkward to see an adult bowing
to a kid.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、ばあちゃんはどこまでも真面目な雰囲
気だった。みさきの方は、ぽかんとしている。
dialogues.en:
But the old lady looks serious. Misaki, on the other hand,
looks surprised.
dialogues.text:
But the old lady looks serious. Misaki, on the other hand,
looks surprised.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「わたしに出来るのは、ここまでなの。わたし
　に出来るのは、話を聞く事だけ……」
dialogues.en:
"This is all I can do for you. I can only be a listener for
you......"
dialogues.text:
"This is all I can do for you. I can only be a listener for
you......"

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp: 「何故って、わたしは魔女だから」
dialogues.en: "It's because I am a witch."
dialogues.text: "It's because I am a witch."

dialogues.speaker: Young Girl
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: そこでばあちゃんは、ふっと微笑んだ。
dialogues.en: The old lady smiles.
dialogues.text: The old lady smiles.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「魔女だから、何でもする力がある。……でも、
　それで誰彼となく助けてあげてしまったら、
　その人のためにならないでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"I have the power to do anything because I'm a witch. ...So
I can help everybody, but it won't do any good to them if I
do, don't you think?"
dialogues.text:
"I have the power to do anything because I'm a witch. ...So
I can help everybody, but it won't do any good to them if I
do, don't you think?"

dialogues.jp:
唐突な話についていけず、みさきは目を丸くし
たままだ。
dialogues.en:
Misaki still looks surprised at the unexpected twist of the
old lady's story.
dialogues.text:
Misaki still looks surprised at the unexpected twist of the
old lady's story.

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「だから、みさきちゃんは、みさきちゃん自身
　のために、頑張って」
dialogues.en: "So you have to try your best for yourself."
dialogues.text: "So you have to try your best for yourself."

dialogues.speaker: Old lady
dialogues.jp:
「頑張って、努力して……それでも駄目だった
　ら、その時は──」
dialogues.en:
"If you try and try harder but still can't do it,
then......"
dialogues.text:
"If you try and try harder but still can't do it,
then......"

dialogues.jp:
風が吹いた。そのせいだろうか。言葉が、一部
しか聞き取れなかった。
dialogues.en:
A gust of wind blows hard, and I can't hear what she has to
say.
dialogues.text:
A gust of wind blows hard, and I can't hear what she has to
say.

dialogues.jp: “桜が……”そう、ばあちゃんは言ったらしい。
dialogues.en: "The cherry tree will......" I think that's what she said.
dialogues.text: "The cherry tree will......" I think that's what she said.

dialogues.jp: 視界が、桜の花びらで埋め尽くされた──。
dialogues.en: And then my view is filled with cherry blossom petals ----
dialogues.text: And then my view is filled with cherry blossom petals ----

dialogues.jp: ◆猫の頼子◆
dialogues.en: ◆I can hear someone crying.◆
dialogues.text: ◆I can hear someone crying.◆

dialogues.jp: 猫を抱いた女の子が泣いていた。
dialogues.en: It's the crying voice of a girl and the mewl of a kitten.
dialogues.text: It's the crying voice of a girl and the mewl of a kitten.

dialogues.jp: 女の子の名前は｛みさき／美咲｝。猫の名前は頼子。

それを慰める一人の老婆、それは俺のばあちゃ
んだった。
dialogues.en:
I can't tell how old the girl is, but I can tell how tall
she is. She's about as tall as Sakura.
dialogues.text:
I can't tell how old the girl is, but I can tell how tall
she is. She's about as tall as Sakura.

dialogues.jp: これは頼子さんの夢なんだろうか……。
dialogues.en:
And there's also a kitten. I don't know what kind the kitten
is... probably it's a tortoiseshell cat with an elegant
attitude.
dialogues.text:
And there's also a kitten. I don't know what kind the kitten
is... probably it's a tortoiseshell cat with an elegant
attitude.
